messages:
ravi: Kicking off canary for hybrid-merge-batcher v1.2 in eng-runtime. This one merges small batches with hot-prefix weighting; early numbers look promising for short-chat and mid-length prompts.
claire: drop the bench numbers please.
ravi: quick harness (chat-short, seq=48 / chat-med, seq=128):
```
Benchmark: chat-short (seq=48)
Baseline    p50=11.9ms  p95=47.8ms  cost=0.114 units
HMB v1.2    p50=8.3ms   p95=45.1ms  cost=0.093 units  (-18.4% cost)

Benchmark: chat-med (seq=128)
Baseline    p50=34.2ms  p95=120.1ms cost=0.358 units
HMB v1.2    p50=31.0ms  p95=118.6ms cost=0.329 units  (-8.1% cost)
```
mohammad: Good p50 gains on short. Any effect on cache churn or duplicated backend tokens?
ravi: Backend token reduction ~11% on short workload, prefix dedupe improved by ~3.5pp. CPU on canary hosts +2.2%, memory +1%. No cold-start regressions in the sample.
deploy-bot: canary started for hybrid-merge-batcher v1.2 (3% us-west) :rocket:
tess: Ops note — watching the "merge-batcher" and "backend-token" panels. Dash link on #oncall: https://console.redwood/perf/hmb-v1.2
maya: Perf QA ran jitter + burst tests; no regressions, though a single synthetic pattern nudged p99 by ~2% which is within our gate. QA :thumbsup:
ravi: Rollout plan: 3% -> 20% at T+1h -> 60% at T+6h -> full at T+24h if all gates clean. Gates: p99 >6% regression OR error-rate >0.5% -> rollback.
claire: runtime-only? any kernel or driver changes?
ravi: runtime-only. Added hybrid-merge heuristic in the packer, a hot-prefix weight table, and a fast-path that bypasses duplicate lookups. No kernel/CUDA changes.
claire: paste toggles please.
ravi: config we enabled on canary:
```yaml
enable_hybrid_merge_batcher: true
hot_prefix_weight: 1.4
merge_max_window_ms: 10
predictive_batch_hint: 14
```
mohammad: Can we get per-tenant cost deltas for the first 24h? Product/Finance want a quick table of winners.
ravi: Kicking per-tenant diff job now, will post results to #finance and tag affected accounts.
perf-bot: regression-check completed — no alerts in the last 30m. :white_check_mark:
maya: tiny ops request: add a short-circuit toggle in case we need a rapid kill during peak.
ravi: added CLI toggle to runbook: `redwood-admin runtime feature disable hmb-v1.2 --env canary`. Also added a health-check that auto-rolls back if p99 gate trips.
claire: Let's wait for the 1h checkpoint before moving to 20%. Thanks team ".
